_approach: A funk-automotivo-style 'tuim' kick-roll build: bar 1 keeps the tamborzão skeleton, bar 2 accelerates the kick from 8ths into a straight 16th roll with velocity climbing to 127 on the final step, tamborim doubling underneath to add lift into the drop. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
